transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess… it’s elevators. I know they’re probably not actually dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get really scared I’ll be trapped in there. I just can’t seem to make myself feel normal about it.
Do you get this same fear in other situations where it might be hard to leave quickly, like buses, tunnels, or crowded places?
Not really sure. I mean… I don’t love crowded places, but it’s not the same. Elevators are the thing I notice.
Besides elevators, are there other places you avoid because leaving quickly would be hard?
I don’t think so. I mean, I avoid elevators when I can, but other places… I haven’t really noticed that same thing.
When you get into an elevator, do you ever suddenly have a panic attack?
Yeah… kind of. Right when the doors start closing, my chest gets tight and my hands get sweaty. I just think, I need to get out, even if it’s only a few floors.
Have you ever had one of these sudden panic attacks when you were not in or about to enter an elevator?
Not that I can think of. It’s mostly just when I’m getting in one, or the doors are closing.
What is the main thing you’re afraid will happen when you’re in an elevator?
Mostly that I’ll get stuck in there… trapped, I guess. I know it doesn’t really make sense, but that’s what hits me.
Do you feel that your fear of elevators is stronger than the actual danger?
Yeah… I mean, I know elevators aren’t really dangerous. But when I have to get in one, it feels like I’m going to get trapped, and I just can’t make myself feel normal about it.
Do you avoid using elevators because of this fear?
Yeah. I usually take the stairs, at my apartment and at work sites. If I really have to use one, I try to have someone I trust with me… otherwise I’ll ask to do something else.
When you avoid elevators, is it because of elevators specifically, or because any place where escape might be hard scares you?
It’s more the elevator itself. I mean… the part where the doors close and I feel like I could get trapped in there. It’s not every place that’s hard to leave.
If someone you trust is with you in the elevator, does the fear mostly go away?

Not really go away, no. It’s… easier if someone I trust is right there with me, but I still don’t like it. Most days I just take the stairs, and if it’s the only way up, I’ll only ride if they’re with me.
Other than elevators, are there any other specific things or situations that scare you in this same way?

No… not really. It’s mainly elevators. I know they’re not really dangerous, but once I have to get in one, I get scared like I’m going to be trapped in there. I can’t really make myself feel normal about it.
